sources: onsemi 2N5457, 2N5458 JFETs – General Purpose, 2N5457/D Rev. 6 (February 2010), from onsemi https://www.onsemi.com/pdf/datasheet/2n5457-d.pdf (onsemi's 2N5458 address /pdf/datasheet/2n5458-d.pdf leads to the documentation page with 'notFound'; 2N5457/D covers both), read 2026-10-31. No LCSC part of onsemi: the catalogue lists only Central Semiconductor's 2N5458 PBFREE (C29630615, no stock), whose host is not reachable from here – the entry is named by its MPN
pins 1 drain, 2 source, 3 gate: p. 1 (1 DRAIN, 2 SOURCE, 3 GATE) and p. 6 case 29-10 style 5 (PIN 1 DRAIN, 2 SOURCE, 3 GATE)
vds_max_v 25, vdg_max_v 25, vgs_max_v 25 (VGSR −25 V: the gate reverse-biased against the source), ig_max_a 0.01, p_max_w 0.31, tj_max_c 135, t_min_c −65: p. 1 maximum ratings

idss_a 2.0 / 6.0 / 9.0 mA (VDS = 15 V, VGS = 0, pulsed) and vgs_off_v −1.0 … −7.0 V (VDS = 15 V, ID = 10 nA, no typical): p. 2 electrical characteristics of the 2N5458 – the spread corners pair the ends (sim/spread.py)

spice: assumption – JFET level 1 by Claude from the typical figures of p. 2, no manufacturer model read: IDSS 6.0 mA typical and VGS −3.5 V typical at ID = 200 µA (printed 'mAdc' with the PDF's micro sign; the 2N5457's −2.5 V at 100 µA sits as far below its IDSS) give with the square law VTO −4.28 V and BETA = IDSS / VTO² = 0.327 mA/V²; LAMBDA 0.0017 /V from the output admittance |Yos| 10 µmhos typical at IDSS
notes: N-channel JFET, TO-92: the Rat's output buffer (a source follower, gate at ground through 1 MΩ, 10 kΩ to ground at the source). IDSS 2 … 9 mA with VGS(off) −1 … −7 V move the source over volts between parts; the spread corners of the simulation show it. Library draft.
